Explicit bounded CLI actor/document/branch arguments only; unknown/duplicate/invalid inputs fail before connection. No arbitrary SQL, target override, HTTP route, hosted service or default startup query.

Reuse existing ServerConfiguration SQL/TLS target policy without reading or changing secrets. Fixed SELECTs only: installed control row, unique canonical normal account enabled/group flags without Password/hash/name/stamp, exact document/branch/status/lock metadata, and existing fixed shape qualification where needed.

No vendor DLL, password verifier, fabricated identity/session, command admission, writer/allocator/journal content, DML/DDL/procedures/COMMIT. Serializable read resources release with rollback/cleanup.
